{{Quote|My inspirations came to me in rumors and dreams, and only now, in the minaret of Ziost, do I realize it was the call of the Sith all along. Sith alchemists have had ages to perfect their art, and their knowledge is now mine.|An extract from the [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|Chronicle]] of [[Sorzus Syn]], 6899 BBY|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''minaret of Ziost''' was a minaret located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> Following the acquirement of the [[Holocron of King Nakgru]] in [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Exile Second Year">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' (p. 27) states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]].</ref> Sorzus Syn studied [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] in the minaret and realized her role as a [[master summoner]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] was the call of the Sith all along.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The minaret of Ziost was first mentioned in the resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
